text: No, the property did not lose tree cover since 2021. While there was a small tree-cover loss of 0.4 ha in 2021, this was in patches under 0.5 ha and does not count as a significant event. The baseline data (as of December 31, 2020) showed no forest cover (0.0% share of the asset), and no additional tree-cover loss events meeting the minimum threshold (0.5 ha) occurred after that date. The most recent observations (up to 2025) confirm no further changes.
